preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is an integer between 1 and 80000 inclusive.
The input contains exactly n - 1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the valid range [1, n].
The graph formed by the nodes and edges is a tree (connected and acyclic).

postconditions.description: The output is the integer count of pairs of paths ((a, b), (c, d)) such that 1 <= a < b <= n, 1 <= c < d <= n, and the shortest path between a and b shares no nodes with the shortest path between c and d.
